role_vocabulary.node: module/box text in a method figure
role_vocabulary.lane-label: rotated layer/lane label in the left gutter
role_vocabulary.data-label: numeric value printed by the code (never retype by hand)
role_vocabulary.annotation: editorial text: arrow labels, callouts, significance marks
